# UKGigTax — full site reference

> UKGigTax (https://www.ukgigtax.com) is an independent UK tax reference for gig workers and delivery drivers. It provides free calculators and plain-English guides for the 2026/27 tax year (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027). Not affiliated with HMRC. All rates are checked against GOV.UK.

## Key 2026/27 figures

- Personal Allowance: £12,570 (income tax starts above this)
- Income Tax (England, Wales, NI): 20% £12,571–£50,270; 40% £50,271–£125,140; 45% above £125,140
- Scottish Income Tax: 19% starter, 20% basic, 21% intermediate, 42% higher, 45% advanced, 48% top
- Class 4 National Insurance: 6% on profits £12,570–£50,270; 2% above £50,270
- Class 2 National Insurance: treated as paid when profits are at least £7,105; voluntary rate £3.65/week
- Trading Allowance: £1,000 of gross income instead of claiming expenses
- VAT registration threshold: £90,000 rolling 12-month turnover
- Mileage (simplified expenses): cars and vans 55p/mile for the first 10,000 business miles, 25p after; motorbikes 24p; bicycles 20p
- Self Assessment registration deadline: 5 October after the end of the tax year; online return and payment 31 January
- Payments on account: required when the previous year's tax bill exceeds £1,000
